issue.title: pip install sase-research-artifacts cannot resolve until sase 0.17.0 ships on PyPI
issue.description: The sase-pt epic plan (plan:202608/research_artifacts_first_release.md, phase 'verify', step 3) explicitly required filing this as a task bead via /sase_new_task; the phase worker (sase-pt.4) deliberately deferred that to the land agent instead of creating it itself. Verified still true by sase-pt.land (2026-08-18) at the time of filing: PyPI's sase package is 0.16.0 (both on PyPI and in this repo's pyproject.toml), while the published sase-research-artifacts==0.2.0 wheel declares Requires-Dist sase>=0.17.0. CI and 'just install' work around this today with an --overrides file pointed at a source checkout (see tools/setup_required_plugins and the install-smoke workflow job), so this does not block internal development, only an outside user's plain 'pip install sase-research-artifacts'. This is deliberate per a comment in sase-research-artifacts' pyproject.toml, not a mistake -- the task is to revisit it once sase 0.17.0 actually ships to PyPI, not to lower the floor now.

task_type_fields.impact: Blocks any outside user (not using this repo's source-checkout --overrides trick) from installing sase-research-artifacts via a plain 'pip install'. README.md and docs/configuration.md in sase-research-artifacts already document the floor; once sase 0.17.0 ships on PyPI, confirm the install resolves naturally and update those docs if their wording assumed the blocker was still open.
task_type_fields.location: sase-research-artifacts pyproject.toml Requires-Dist (repo sase-org/sase-research-artifacts, open via 'sase repo open sase-research-artifacts'); PyPI sase project at https://pypi.org/project/sase/
task_type_fields.repro: In a clean environment with no source overrides: 'uv pip install sase-research-artifacts==0.2.0' (or plain pip) fails to resolve because it requires sase>=0.17.0 and PyPI's sase package is only at 0.16.0.

payload.entry: MECHANISM UPDATE from sase-p3.15.land (landing epic sase-p3.15, 2026-08-18). This bead stays closed-canceled -- the owner's 'That is to be expected' still holds and epic phase sase-p3.15.3 independently hit the same wall, so no new task was filed. One factual correction for whoever revisits this once sase 0.17.0 ships: this description says CI and 'just install' work around the floor 'with an --overrides file pointed at a source checkout (see tools/setup_required_plugins ...)'. That is no longer how it works. The only --overrides file in this repo is Justfile:_core-overrides-arg, which lifts the published sase-core-rs window and has nothing to do with this plugin. tools/setup_required_plugins passes --no-deps on every install, so the wheel's Requires-Dist sase>=0.17.0 is never resolved and PyPI sase 0.16.0 is never consulted; sase-p3.15.3 also removed the git+https://github.com/sase-org/<repo> fallback the tool briefly had. Verified live in workspace sase_12 at HEAD 11f78656d: 'just install' with no linked checkout installs sase-research-artifacts 0.2.0 from PyPI and 'import sase_research_artifacts' succeeds, while a plain resolving 'uv pip install sase-research-artifacts' still cannot resolve. So the blast radius is exactly what this bead says (outside users only), but the internal workaround is --no-deps, not an overrides file.
